correctness.rationale: The labelled F₂^k orbit-multiset normal form is unique, the two-variable pair-type counting induction is valid with binary relation symbols, and the minimum orbit size for a signature with r nonzero classes is exactly 2^ceil(log₂(r+1)). These facts prove both enumerative products. At orbit size at most four the signature determines the subgroup; for three generators the only collision between subgroups occurs for the all-singleton signature with sizes four and eight, giving exactly one size-eight pair. Independent finite scripts verify subgroup enumeration, generating coefficients, and the witness including its three-variable separation; finite tests are corroboration not universal proof.

value.rationale: The final contribution is the exact generating function counting complete two-variable theories of finite elementary abelian permutation actions for arbitrary numbers of named generators, with Stirling exponents and orbit-size thresholds; the comparison to the classical isomorphism generating function isolates a unique first ambiguity for three generators at size eight. These are explicit natural model-theoretic invariants that a previously available general C² signature criterion does not numerically determine without new algebraic classification. The general logical equivalence criterion is not assigned separate value as a new result.
